ks-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
ks-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Kansas's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
ks-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

ks-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City card names the city you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
ks-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Kansas's cities has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
ks-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's mayor or council members, or a city's own published list of them.

ks-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
ks-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Kansas's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
ks-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

ks-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation whose land you clicked on, with its seat and website. It names the Prairie Band Potawatomi Nation's council, and not yet the other three nations' councils.
ks-tribal-government.why: This app has not read the council lists of Kansas's other three nations yet. Each nation publishes its own, which has to be read one nation at a time.
ks-tribal-government.wanted: Each nation's own published list of its council, read one nation at a time.
